name: PLAY | 200mg Gummies | Peach
description:
Get ready to Play harder with every bite. These sugar-coated Peach Gummies hit with a sweet mix of juicy peach and a smooth, balanced high. Each piece packs 50mg of THC for bold flavor and an even bolder vibe.

Perfect for seasoned consumers who like to keep things sweet, strong, and on-the-go.

Flavor: peach

Texture: Sugar-dusted and chewy

Potency: 50mg THC per gummy (200mg total)

Vibe: Sweet, uplifting, and ready to Play.
